Test "Health‑focused vs convenience‑focused body‑fat analyser test" between T1; T2. Method: Online survey with simulated purchase offer. Participants are randomly assigned to one of two groups. Group A sees a health‑focused message: 'Measure your body fat risk and reduce heart disease, diabetes and cancer risk.' Group B sees a convenience‑focused message: 'Get an instant one‑button body‑fat measurement for quick health tracking.' Both groups see a price point of €199 for a basic home scale. Participants indicate purchase intent (1‑10) and the primary reason they would buy.. Sample: 400 adults aged 18‑95 in the United States, screened for health concern and willingness to pay for a home scale.. Measure: Purchase intent score (1‑10) and primary reason for purchase (open‑ended)..
